title: MUSEWALK MINI
subtitle: STEP INTO THE PAINTING
tagline: Classical · Modern · Future — walk among the masters, step inside a painting, dissolve into stardust.
footnote: Arrow keys / WASD to walk · Click the floor to travel · Drag to look around · Headphones recommended

wings.name: Van Gogh
wings.intro: A compact six-painting route through Van Gogh: night skies, sunflowers, blossoms, a bedroom, irises, and a cafe terrace.

artists.name: Vincent van Gogh
artists.place: 津德尔特 / 阿尔勒 / 奥维尔
artists.bio: He sold one painting in his lifetime, and became the whole world's beloved after it. In ten years he made more than eight hundred canvases, pressing pain, loneliness and an almost reckless love of life into the paint, stroke by stroke, thick enough to stand. He said: 'I dream my painting, and then I paint my dream.'

works.title: The Starry Night
works.museum: Museum of Modern Art, New York
works.desc: Through the barred window of the asylum at Saint-Rémy, he watched the sky churn into whirlpools, stars swelling like fireworks. This is not what the night looks like — it is what the night feels like, burning inside a troubled mind.
works.line: He painted the roaring in his ears into a whirlpool of stars.

works.title: Sunflowers
works.desc: He painted vase after vase of sunflowers to dress the little house for Gauguin's arrival. Full bloom and withering share one vase — not flowers, but friendship, and the whole of his hunger for life.
works.line: Blooming and wilting in a single vase, like his short and burning life.

works.title: Almond Blossom
works.desc: Painted for a newborn nephew: white blossoms opening against a blue sky, the gentlest blessing he could imagine.
works.line: He mailed an entire spring to a child just born.

works.title: The Bedroom
works.desc: The tilted floor, the paired pillows — he wanted to paint 'absolute rest', but the brushstrokes are still feverish.
works.line: He painted a steady bed, and never slept well himself.

works.title: Irises
works.desc: The flowerbed from his first week in the asylum: every blue is struggling out of the soil.
works.line: One white iris stands among the blue, the way he stood in a crowd.

works.title: Café Terrace at Night
works.desc: A night painted without a single stroke of black — gaslight yellow and starlit blue refusing to yield to each other.
works.line: Night doesn't have to be dark — he called a sky of stars as witness.
